listing.detail: Type a GitHub username on bilko.run and get a hosted portfolio plus printable résumé, ranked by recency and activity. Free: your top 3 projects, rebuilt at most once a day when viewed. $5/mo: pick up to 12 repos, refreshed daily.
listing.audience: Developers who want their GitHub activity to double as a portfolio.
talkingPoints: Type your GitHub username at bilko.run/projects/git-viewer/ — no install, no signup to see it.
Turns your public GitHub repos into a portfolio page and a print-ready résumé.
Ranks repos by recency and activity.
Free shows your top 3 projects, rebuilt at most once a day when someone views it.
$5/mo lets you pick up to 12 repos and refreshes them daily.
listing.callToAction: Type your GitHub username at https://bilko.run/projects/git-viewer/
avoidClaims: Updates instantly when you push code
Shows every public repo on the free tier
